sentences.text:
The instant bail application has been filed by the petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C in connection with FIR No.227/2021 registered at Police Station Kuchera, District Nagaur,
for the offences under Sections 420, 406, 465, 468, 120-B of IPC and under Sections 66-C and 66-D of IT Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that co-accused persons namely, Rahul Kumar Gautam S/o Meva Lal, Abraham Jafar Khan S/o Abdul Jafar Khan and Sahil Berry S/o Sh. Ranjan Berry (S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos.1044/2022, 637/2022 and 2617/2022) have already been enlarged on bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide orders dated 04.02.2022 and 25.02.2022,
respectively.

entities.text: S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail Application Nos.1044/2022, 637/2022 and 2617/2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Learned counsel further submitted that the Court of Sessions Judge No.1, Nagaur (2 of 3) [CRLMB-8844/2023] vide order dated 23.12.2022 has granted bail under Section 439 Cr.P.C. to one Vinay Kumar S/o Shatruhan.

entities.text: Court of Sessions Judge No.1, Nagaur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel submitted that the case of the present petitioner is not distinguishable from that of co-accused persons who have already been enlarged on bail.
He prayed that benefit of bail may be granted to the accused-petitioner.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the offences alleged against the petitioner are triable by Magistrate.

The accused-petitioner is behind the bars since 21.06.2023 and the trial of the case will take sufficiently long time to conclude, therefore, the benefit of bail may be granted to the Monika Berry vs State Of Rajasthan on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/187926802/

Per contra

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: , learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel for the complainant have opposed the bail application.
Learned counsel for the complainant submitted that co-accused persons were enlarged on bail after filing of challan and in the present case challan has not yet been filed.

However, he was not in position to dispute the fact that co-accused persons namely Rahul Kumar Gautam, Abraham Jafar Khan, Sahil Berry S/o Sh. Ranjan Berry and Vinay Kumar have already been enlarged on bail by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.

In the prima facie opinion of this Court, the case of the present petitioner is not distinguishable from that of co-accused persons, therefore, looking to the overall facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

(3 of 3) [CRLMB-8844/2023] Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that the accused-petitioner-Monika Berry W/o Sh. Sahil Berry shall be enlarged on bail in connection with FIR No.227/2021 registered at Police Station Kuchera, District Nagaur,
provided she furnishes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- with two sureties of Rs.25,000/-
each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Judge for her appearance before the court concerned on all the dates of hearing as and when called upon to do so.

(KULDEEP MATHUR),J 243-KshamaD/-
